mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0) as amount, COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM `t_order` WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status = 3 AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time) ASC
SELECT status as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM t_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND seller_id = #{sellerId} GROUP BY status
